proof_candidate_review_standards.description: Formal standards for proof-candidate review within the Mono-Process Framework.
proof_candidate_review_standards.required_dependency_resolution: All reduction-chain steps must reach derivation_supported status; all primitive dependencies must be mapped.
proof_candidate_review_standards.required_boundary_case_preservation: All identified boundary cases must be explicitly classified and traceable to behavior.
proof_candidate_review_standards.required_counterexample_review: Proof must survive the MT-Counterexample Campaign; obligations must be registered and discharged.
proof_candidate_review_standards.required_failure_mode_preservation: All failure modes must remain visible in registries and linked to the target proof.
proof_candidate_review_standards.required_quantifier_and_equivalence_chec: Scope of universal/existential quantifiers must be explicit; equivalence requirements must be proven locally.

machine_checkable_vs_human_review_status.machine_checkable: Logic-chain integrity, dependency resolution, hash consistency.
machine_checkable_vs_human_review_status.human_review: Semantic interpretation, physical humility check, overreach audit.

authorization_requirements: Explicit user directive for status elevation
Zero active blocker count for target object
